declarations.name: AccessoryLiveActivity
declarations.comment:
`AccessoryLiveActivity` is the structured object delivered to an accessory data extension.
It contains identity information about the activity, its current state, and the associated content, if any.

members.name: sourceBundleIcon
members.comment: An icon representation for the source bundle that created the live activity

members.name: sourceBundleName
members.comment: The name of the app that the activity content originated from.

members.name: sourceBundleIdentifier
members.comment: The bundle identifier of the app that the activity content originated from.

members.name: state
members.comment: The current state of the activity.

members.name: content
members.comment: The view content of the live activity

declarations.name: AccessoryLiveActivity.Content
declarations.comment: `Content` carries the presentable information for a given activity update.

declarations.name: AccessoryLiveActivity.Content.AlertMessage
declarations.comment:
An alert message associated with this update, if the update is alerting.

Present when the system determines this update should alert the user. Accessories
can use this to display a notification-style alert when the activity changes.

members.name: body
members.comment: The body text of the alert.

declarations.name: AccessoryLiveActivity.IconFile
declarations.comment: `IconFile` provides on-demand access to a source app's icon.

members.name: url
members.signature: var url: URL { get async throws }
members.comment:
The URL to the app icon file on disk.

Accessing this property performs an async fetch. The caller is responsible for
reading the file before the URL becomes invalid.

declarations.name: LiveActivityForwarding
declarations.comment:
`LiveActivityForwarding` is an `AccessoryFeature` for developers to include in their `DataProvider`
extension point declaration to receive information about forwardable live activity content to other accessory devices
paired through `AccessorySetupKit.framework`.

members.name: authorization
members.signature: static func authorization(forAccessory accessory: ASAccessory) async throws -> AccessoryAuthorizationResult
members.comment:
Fetch the user's authorization decision for live activity forwarding.

- Parameter accessory: The accessory whose authorization settings should be managed.
- Returns: The user's authorization decision.

members.name: presentAuthorizationSheet
members.signature: static func presentAuthorizationSheet(forAccessory accessory: ASAccessory) async throws -> AccessoryAuthorizationResult
members.comment:
Presents the authorization management UI for an already-registered accessory.

Use this to allow the user to update which apps' Live Activities are forwarded
to the accessory.

- Parameter accessory: The accessory whose authorization settings should be managed.
- Returns: The user's updated authorization decision.

members.name: featureID
members.comment: The identifier used to declare this capability in the DataProvider extension.

declarations.name: LiveActivityForwarding.Session
declarations.comment:
A `Session` represents the active connection between the `DataProvider` extension and the system.
A session can query data or send data to a transport extension for delivery to their accessory.

members.name: liveActivities
members.signature: final var liveActivities: [AccessoryLiveActivity] { get async throws }

- Returns:  all currently active live activities the session is authorized for
